comment: Model matrix. All three providers expose an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint, so one client library covers everything; only base_url and the API key differ. 'tier' is a label for analysis (frontier = newest/largest, legacy = older/smaller). Edit freely; run with --smoke-test after changing model ids. Note: deepseek-chat is the legacy alias which, as of mid-2026, points at deepseek-v4-flash in non-thinking mode (the true V3-era models are no longer served first-party); it is scheduled for retirement on 2026-07-24.
